target.name: whole_molecule_lipophilicity
target.normalization: official Train only, mean and population std (ddof=0)
target.metric: RMSE and MAE in original label units

sentence.definition: full radius-2 rooted ego graph with every real induced bond
sentence.trunk: non-iterative LCRC-style S1 / typed S2 / complete R2 summaries
sentence.h_usage: candidate score query only; never enters the final prediction directly

candidate_word.boundary_definition: real induced bonds from S to R2(v) \ S

selection.normalization_scope: all candidates owned by the same root

prediction.formula: beta + c_n*log1p(n_atoms) + c_m*log1p(n_physical_bonds) + sum_v dot(a,z_v) + sum_e dot(lambda_e,U(z_u)*U(z_v))/sqrt(16)

recipe.early_stopping: epoch >= min_epochs and epoch - best_valid_epoch >= patience

verdict.gine_note: historical recipe differs; descriptive only, not a matched control
verdict.word_evidence: multi-atom alpha mass, non-zero contribution, cross-molecule support and sign distribution; no single top-word claim
verdict.word_evidence_rule: if Valid RMSE > 0.70 -> STOP_THIS_IMPLEMENTATION; otherwise weak if Train multi-atom alpha mass < 0.10 or Train multi-atom absolute-contribution share < 0.10 -> PREDICTIVE_BUT_WORD_EVIDENCE_WEAK; otherwise CONTINUE_DISCUSSION

word_reuse.canonicalization: exact root-fixed permutation enumeration over at most 3 non-root atoms; full 9 atom and 3 bond categorical fields
word_reuse.ranking: Train mean absolute contribution; no Valid/Test labels or effects
